_comment: marble_trapdoor: the walkway trapdoor's moving parts, for the hole marble_build cuts on a pier in TRAPDOOR_BEARINGS: four lane cells from the section wall's strip to the wall, over its stepped pit (a 1.4 m ledge r 48.05..52 over the lower tier's cells, a 10.4 m shaft from r 52 to the wall). Origin the deck point at r 53.989 (mid-hole) on the hole's centre bearing, y 0 the deck, +X radial out, +Z toward increasing bearing. TrapdoorFrame: near-black iron rim inside the hole, 0.35 deep, its lane sides straight chords (0.28 m at the narrowest), five knuckles along each hinge. TrapdoorLeaf00 (inner, hinged on the lip chord) and TrapdoorLeaf01 (outer, on the wall chord): two 0.15 m stone flaps, 1.15 m (inner) and 9.9 m (outer), meeting at a seam along the lane at r 49.5, darker worn flags, five iron strap hinges and an iron lip on the free edge, iron undersides; node origin is the hinge axis at the flap's bottom arris, local +X along the hinge, local +Z toward the free edge: +90 deg about local X hangs it (the inner to 1.3 m in the ledge, the outer to 10.1 m in the shaft). TrapdoorSpikes: pale stone spikes on a 0.9 m grid over both floors (y -1.4 and -10.4), tips 0.3..0.55 over each, 0.45 m clear of the rim and the step. NO colliders: the scene gives the flaps their bodies.
